parameters.notes: ORCHESTRATOR: routing + state + validation + retries + persistence + errors + audit. NO LLM, NO scoring. Flow: intake -> products -> vendors -> review&quality -> comparison -> decision -> (negotiation if NEGOTIATE) -> respond. Missing data continues as PARTIAL, never fabricated. Statuses: created -> product_done -> (vendor_done) -> quality_done -> compared.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ procurement_id: $('Validate Intake').first().json.procurement_id, note: 'Phase 2B ends after decision/negotiation-prep.' }) }}

nodes.name: Negotiate?
nodes.notes: Reads the persisted decision output (Execute nodes return pg results, so conditions reference agent nodes explicitly). Only NEGOTIATE enters negotiation.

nodes.name: Negotiation Open?
nodes.notes: decided -> negotiating ONLY when a real negotiation opened. Otherwise no transition.

nodes.name: Vendor Response Webhook
nodes.notes: Async entry for REAL vendor responses (email/API/portal payloads). No response -> no reevaluation, case stays negotiating. Never synthesize.

nodes.name: Reevaluated?
nodes.notes: WAITING_FOR_VENDOR / NOT_ELIGIBLE / REJECTED stay negotiating. No transition without verified recomputation.

nodes.name: Call Approval (waits for human)
nodes.notes: Pauses at the HITL Wait node until an explicit human decision arrives. Never auto-resolves.

nodes.name: Proceed Path?
nodes.notes: INSUFFICIENT_DATA ends at decided (audit only). PROCEED goes to approval unless the explicit auto-close rule applies.

nodes.name: Auto-close?
nodes.notes: decided -> closed ONLY under the explicit PROCEED business rule (default false). Recorded in audit.

nodes.name: Demo Negotiation Webhook
nodes.notes: DEMO entry: body {procurement_id, offer_id, mode:'DEMO', reason, target_price?}. REAL flow untouched. NOTHING is sent to any vendor from any branch below.
